programs.source:
for original in [84, 9973, 15625, 1001, 123456, 48000, 999958, 999999]
    remaining, divisor = original, 2
    factors = String[]
    while divisor * divisor <= remaining
        factor_power = 0
        while remaining % divisor == 0
            remaining = div(remaining, divisor)
            factor_power += 1
        end
        if factor_power > 0
            push!(
                factors,
                factor_power == 1 ? string(divisor) : string(divisor, "^", factor_power),
            )
        end
        divisor += 1
    end
    if remaining > 1
        push!(factors, string(remaining))
    end
    println(original, " = ", join(factors, " * "))
end
